model.title: Expanded Consular Fellows Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Jacky Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would let the State Department hire certain staff for consular work, such as visa processing and services for Americans abroad, on temporary non-career appointments lasting up to 8 years, instead of the current maximum of 5 years. It would also add a new 2-year temporary appointment option for consular personnel, and it sets out findings about the importance of consular services, rising demand tied to major international sporting events between 2024 and 2034, and the need to expand staffing to keep these services running efficiently.
